title: 2026 mein app banane ka kharcha
content:
2026 mein app banane ka kharcha kitna padega?

Pehla, design.
Figma muft hai.
Google ka Stitch use karo.
Bahut accha tool hai.

Doosra, code.
Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, Claude Code.
Ye sab muft milte hain.

Teesra, deploy.
Supabase ya Firebase.
Dono ka muft tier use kar sakte ho.
App badhe, to paid plan pe chale jaana.

Chautha, login.
Clerk ya Supabase.
Dono ka auth use kar sakte ho.
Login, sign up, Google, sab sambhal jaata hai.

Phir AI features.
Gemini ya Claude ki API.
Muft milti hain.

Test ke liye iOS pe TestFlight.
Android pe Firebase Test Lab.
Dono muft hain.

App Store saal ka 99 dollar leta hai.
Play Store zindagi bhar ke liye 25 dollar leta hai.
Payment ka cut 2 percent hai.

Kul kharcha roughly 140 se 150 dollar.
